notes.title: Update 03. Silver Knight early version 1.0.0.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 03. Silver Knight early version 1.0.0.3 [/h1]


[b]Traps [/b]

- Ice trap (Now you can freeze enemies) 
- Insect trap (The enemy gets damage from insects) 
- Sheep trap (Transforms the enemy into a sheep) 

[b]New Skill(s) [/b]

- Throwing a sword at the opponent using the mouse (To throw a sword you will have to find one) 

[b]New changes! [/b]

- If you kill all the monsters in the room you will get a chest where you can get new items from! 

- Dust created from the character's feet while walking. 

- After you get back to the same room were you have already killed the    enemies, they won't respawn again in that room.

- There is now a death animation when the player dies. 

- If you get hit a red indicator will appear on the sides of the screen. 

- If you only have one life, the entire screen will be darker. 

- While beating your opponent over his head appears the number of how much you hit him.

- Sound for dash. 

- Intro has been moved to the menu where you can see it by clicking the button "Intro" 

[b]Control of the game has changed![/b]

Move: W = Forward - A = Left - S = Backwards - D = Right 
Bombs: E 
Traps: Q 
Dash, Teleportation: SPACE 

Mouse 
Attack - LEFT BUTTON 
Shoot - RIGHT BUTTON 

You can still use Numpad 1 and 2 
Screen resize - Z 

[b]Currently disabled [/b]

- Boss Spiders and Loki's

- Enemy Pigs, Spiders and Imps


With future updates, they will be repaired, and added, along with other things. 


[b]Also i fixed things that you were asking. [/b]


[h1]If you have any ideas what to add or remove from game please write or draw.ːsteamhappyː[/h1]
